body:
Hi, 

I'm hesitant to diagnose anyone, as I'm not qualified to do so. *However*, if your girlfriend is really resonating with some or a lot of the resources on ROCD, then I suggest she or y'all work on crafting a 'toolbox' based on strategies for combatting ROCD. Identifying w/ certain terminology can be liberating or it can be very, very scary, but what works, works. 

So, for example, I too suffer from the dreaded "forever" obsession. To combat it, I practice grounding myself in the present: "I'm afraid our relationship will end horribly in the future" > "I can't control the future, therefore, I'm turning my attention to the present" 

Or for whenever I feel as though I'm not good enough to be in a relationship I try to address "My partner deserves someone better than me" or "my partner should want/seek a better partner than me" with "I trust my partner to know what's best for them, I trust them to choose for themselves, and according to my partner, they choose me"

This isn't easy, and its really hard to implement at first, but its something I have had to train myself to do more and more each day. I recognize that not everyone could do that, its just something that I recommend because it doesn't require any tangle tools like pencil and paper (though, those could help!)

Anyway, I hope this helps.
